caption: The drawing depicts a long, formal dress featuring a combination of pastel colors and floral patterns. The bodice is structured with a fitted shape and is decorated with a lace-like or embroidered detail at the chest, beneath a wide, high collar in pink. The sleeves are large, voluminous, and puffed in a pale blue color, accented with inner layers of pink ruffled fabric. The skirt of the dress extends to the floor and has a central panel in pale blue, flanked on both sides by panels covered in a light green fabric adorned with small pink and white floral designs. A blue-and-pink ruffled trim runs along the bottom hem of the dress. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, uncolored outline sketch of the same dress, presenting the garment in a simplified line drawing without any color or detail, showing the front and partial side view. The background is plain and lightly tinged with beige, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Dress
